verdict.rationale: Capacities documents daily notes uniquely linked to each day, with a section showing that day's references, and a community user praises its daily-notes implementation. Templates can prefill object properties and blocks, but the evidence never says they apply to daily notes, or that daily notes are created automatically or open as the default landing page. Missing for 10: evidence of automatic daily-note creation, templates applied specifically to daily notes, daily note as the default landing place for capture.
